start.noServersHeading: Al momento non è disponibile alcun server

start.question: Vuoi avviare comunque il torneo?

wizard.shuffleInfo: I tornei shuffle non usano squadre fisse. I giocatori vengono distribuiti automaticamente in squadre bilanciate a ogni match in base allo Skill Rating.
wizard.shuffleRounds: Questo torneo shuffle avrà circa {{rounds}} (uno per ogni mappa selezionata).
wizard.volumeAlert: Con {{teams}} in un torneo {{type}} in {{format}}, questo tabellone avrà circa {{matches}} distribuiti su {{rounds}} (fino a {{maps}} in totale).
wizard.maxRoundsHelper: Ogni mappa si gioca fino a {{maxRounds}} round; vince chi arriva prima a {{winRounds}} round.
wizard.maxRoundsHelperEmpty: Numero massimo di round per mappa (predefinito: 24, max: 30).
wizard.serversSummary: Server configurati: {{servers}}; il primo round prevede {{matches}}.
wizard.playerRegistrationInfo_one: I giocatori verranno registrati dopo la creazione del torneo. Ogni mappa selezionata corrisponde a un round di match ({{count}} round in totale).
wizard.playerRegistrationInfo_other: I giocatori verranno registrati dopo la creazione del torneo. Ogni mappa selezionata corrisponde a un round di match ({{count}} round in totale).
wizard.serversSummaryQueued: Server configurati: {{servers}}; il primo round prevede {{matches}}. I match oltre il numero di server restano in coda finché un server non si libera.

overtime.modeHelper: L'overtime standard gioca segmenti extra finché una squadra non passa in vantaggio. «Pareggi consentiti» chiude in parità una mappa in equilibrio, mentre «nessun pareggio» la decide in base al danno totale della squadra.
overtime.tooltip: Controlla l’overtime e come vengono gestiti i pareggi al numero massimo di round. Queste impostazioni vengono passate ai server di gioco come overtimeMode/overtimeSegments e valgono allo stesso modo per i tornei shuffle e le partite manuali.
overtime.shuffleTooltip: Controlla il comportamento dell'overtime nei match shuffle e come vengono decisi i pareggi al massimo dei round. Con l'overtime disattivato, i match in parità possono restare pareggi oppure essere decisi dal danno totale della squadra, a seconda dell'opzione scelta.
overtime.segmentsHelper: Facoltativo: limita il numero di segmenti di overtime. Lascia vuoto per il predefinito del server di gioco.
overtime.segmentsHelperValue_one: Limita l'overtime a {{count}} segmento. In caso di parità dopo l'overtime decide il danno totale della squadra.
overtime.segmentsHelperValue_other: Limita l'overtime a {{count}} segmenti. In caso di parità dopo l'overtime decide il danno totale della squadra.

grandFinal.label: Grand Final

options.simple: Semplice – una sola Grand Final tra i vincitori del bracket vincenti e perdenti
options.none: Nessuna – la finale del bracket vincenti decide il torneo (nessuna Grand Final)
options.double: Doppia – con bracket‑reset (per ora si comporta come Semplice; il supporto completo è previsto)

grandFinal.helper: Controlla come i vincitori dei bracket vincenti e perdenti si affrontano alla fine del torneo.

mapPool.shuffleTitle: Selezione delle mappe per i tornei shuffle
mapPool.shuffleBody: Tutte le mappe selezionate vengono giocate in sequenza. Ogni mappa corrisponde a un round di match. Il numero di mappe scelte determina quanti round verranno giocati.

formatStep.shuffleInfo: I tornei shuffle usano il formato best of 1. Ogni match si gioca su una sola mappa.

shuffleConfig.subtitle: Regole e impostazioni dei match
shuffleConfig.teamSizeTooltip: Numero di giocatori per squadra. Opzioni comuni: 4v4, 5v5, 6v6. Minimo 2 e massimo 10 giocatori per squadra.
shuffleConfig.teamSizeHelper: Numero di giocatori per squadra (predefinito: 5 per il 5v5, intervallo: 2-10)
shuffleConfig.maxRoundsTooltip: Numero massimo di round per partita. Il valore viene passato ai server CS2 come mp_maxrounds. Esempio: 6 = MR6, 24 = MR24.
shuffleConfig.maxRoundsHelper: Il match si gioca fino a {{maxRounds}} round; vince chi arriva prima a {{winRounds}} round
shuffleConfig.maxRoundsHelperEmpty: Numero massimo di round per match (predefinito: 24, max: 30)
shuffleConfig.eloTemplateTooltip: Scegli come viene calcolato l'ELO in questo torneo. Per impostazione predefinita il modello «Pure Win/Loss» usa solo il risultato del match (vittoria/sconfitta); le statistiche vengono registrate ma non modificano l'ELO. Gli altri modelli sono facoltativi e aggiungono correzioni basate sulle statistiche alla variazione OpenSkill, se preferisci un comportamento in stile Excel.
shuffleConfig.eloTemplateHelper: Pure Win/Loss (predefinito): solo il risultato del match incide sull'ELO. Le statistiche dei giocatori vengono comunque registrate per classifiche ed esportazioni, ma non modificano il punteggio a meno che tu non scelga un modello personalizzato.

shuffleStats.serverShortageWarning: You have {{available}} of {{needed}} servers. Matches will run in waves, so rounds take longer.

changePreview.title: Rivedi le modifiche al torneo

teamSelection.notEnoughServers: Il primo round prevede {{matches}}, ma hai {{servers}}. I match oltre il numero di server restano in coda finché un server non si libera — aggiungi altri server per giocarli tutti in contemporanea.
teamSelection.notEnoughTeams: Servono almeno 2 squadre per creare un torneo. Al momento ne hai {{teams}}.

eventPage.title: Event page
eventPage.subtitle: Shown to players and visitors on the public Overview page.
eventPage.rulebookUrlHelper: Must be an https link, or leave it empty.
eventPage.bannerHelp: A wide image across the top of the tournament page. PNG, JPEG or WEBP, up to 2 MB; 1920 × 600 works well.
eventPage.bannerWrongType: The banner must be a PNG, JPEG or WEBP image.
eventPage.bannerTooLarge: The banner must be 2 MB or smaller.
eventPage.signupHelp: A team's owner or captain signs up with a lineup. Lineup players check in on the day.
eventPage.startsAtHelp: Your local time. The site counts down to it.
eventPage.autoStartLabel: Start the tournament automatically at this time
eventPage.bannerMapLabel: No banner? Use a map's picture

game.title: Which game?
game.lede: The game decides how matches are run and which settings you get.

basics.title: What is it called?
basics.lede: Give the tournament a name players will recognise, and pick how ratings change.

format.title: How is it played?
format.lede: Pick the bracket and how long each series is. You can change this until the tournament starts.

teams.title: Who is playing?
teams.lede: Pick the teams in the bracket. You can create or import teams here too.
teams.ledeShuffle: Shuffle has solo sign-up: players register, and new teams are drawn each round.

maps.title: Which maps?
maps.lede: Pick the map pool. Series use the veto to choose their maps from it.
maps.ledeShuffle: Pick the maps in the order they are played. Each map is one round.

eventPage.title: What goes on the event page?
eventPage.lede: Optional. Shown to players and visitors on the public Overview page.

review.title: Ready to go?
review.lede: Check the details, then create the tournament.
review.ledeExisting: Check the details, then start the tournament when everyone is ready.

schedule.title: When do matches start?
schedule.lede: At set times, with the veto opening before each match, or as soon as both teams and a server are ready.

extras.title: Rules and extras
extras.lede: How rounds are played, what the placings win, and how ratings are counted.

game.label: Game
game.loading: Loading the games this instance can run.
game.lockedHelp: The game is fixed once the tournament exists. Delete it and start again to run a different one.

integrationDescriptions.cs2: Le partite si giocano sui tuoi server CS2 con Ready Up.
integrationDescriptions.manual-report: No servers. Teams play the match themselves and a captain reports the result.

basics.ratingHelp: How player ratings change after each match in this tournament.

format.label: Format

types.single_elimination: Lose once and you're out. Fastest.
types.double_elimination: A second chance in the lower bracket.
types.swiss: Teams play several rounds against similar records.
types.round_robin: Everyone plays everyone. Best for small groups.
types.shuffle: Solo sign-up. New balanced teams each round.
types.groups: Round robin in groups; the best of each go on to a final or a bracket.

grandFinalHelp.simple: The winners and losers bracket champions meet in one grand final.
grandFinalHelp.double: Bracket reset. For now it is played like one grand final; full reset support is planned.
grandFinalHelp.none: No grand final: the winners bracket final decides the tournament.

format.teamsHelpPowerOfTwo: Elimination brackets need {{counts}} teams. Used for the summary until you pick teams.
format.teamsHelpRange: Between {{min}} and {{max}} teams. Used for the summary until you pick teams.
format.cs2Help: Passato ai tuoi server CS2 dal modulo di gioco Counter-Strike 2.

teams.shuffleBeforeCreate: Players sign up after you create the tournament. Come back to this step to choose them.
teams.shuffleSelfSignup: I giocatori si iscrivono da soli
teams.shuffleSelfSignupHelp: Finché è attivo si iscrivono con «Unisciti» nella pagina del torneo; qui puoi comunque aggiungere giocatori.

maps.vetoStandard: Each {{format}} series runs the map veto: the teams ban and pick from these 7 maps.
maps.vetoCustom: This tournament has a custom veto order for {{format}}.
maps.vetoShuffle: Shuffle has no veto: the maps are played in this order, one per round.

eventPage.draftNote: Saved with the tournament when you create it.

review.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Save them (the bracket is generated again) or discard them before starting.

manualReport.title: Manual reporting
manualReport.help: Auto Tournament cannot watch this game, so the teams tell it what happened.
manualReport.seriesLengthHelp: How many games a series is. The first team to win more than half of them takes the match.
manualReport.gameLabelHelp: What to call it in the report form. Leave empty for “{{game}}”.
manualReport.allowDrawHelp: Allow a game, and so a series, to end level. Leave off for a bracket, where somebody has to go through.

confirmationHelp.opponent: The other team's captain has to agree before the match is settled. They can dispute it instead, which sends it to an admin.
confirmationHelp.none: A captain's report settles the match on its own. Quick, and worth it only where nobody is likely to disagree.

manualReport.confirmTimeoutHelp: How long the opponent has before the deadline is reached. 1440 is a day.
manualReport.confirmTimeoutNone: No deadline: the report waits for an answer.

timeoutActionHelp.auto_confirm: The report is taken as reported, and the bracket moves on without anybody waiting.
timeoutActionHelp.escalate: The match is handed to an admin, who decides it on the Disputes page.

signup.organizerHelp: You pick every team. Nobody can sign up from the tournament page.
signup.openHelp: A team's owner or captain signs up with a lineup from the tournament page, and the lineup checks in on the day. You can still add teams yourself below.
signup.teamSizeHelp: Starters a team picks when it signs up (up to 2 subs on top).
signup.noneYet: No teams yet. They show up here as they sign up.

groups.seeding: How teams are put in groups
groups.ties: Ties in a group: head-to-head, then round difference, then rounds won (same as round robin). If the groups don't fill a bracket, the best of the rest go through too.
groups.playoffFinal: The two group winners: a {{format}} final
groups.previewNote: In the order of the teams list (the seeding). Groups lock when the tournament starts.
groups.randomNote: The groups are drawn at random when the tournament starts.

schedule.timesNote: Matches wait for their time. Players see it on the match, get a reminder, and the veto opens on time.
schedule.breakNote_one: A team that just played gets a {{count}}-minute break before its next veto (Match rules).
schedule.breakNote_other: A team that just played gets a {{count}}-minute break before its next veto (Match rules).
schedule.noBreakNote: There is no break between a team's matches (Match rules).
schedule.ownTimeNote: Give one match its own time in Manage › Schedule once the bracket is made.

extras.gotvOn_one: Spectators can watch in GOTV, {{count}} second behind (Match rules › Spectators).
extras.gotvOn_other: Spectators can watch in GOTV, {{count}} seconds behind (Match rules › Spectators).
extras.gotvOff: Spectators can't watch in GOTV (Match rules › Spectators).

archiveDialog.title: Start a new tournament?
archiveDialog.message: {{name}} is archived. Its results, matches and stats stay, and its page keeps its address. Then you create the next one.
archiveDialog.deleteHint: Or delete it: its results, matches and stats go with it.

end.tooltip: Stops the tournament now without a result: matches on servers end, the rest are cancelled. No winner and no rewards. It can be archived afterwards.
end.title: End this tournament?
end.body: Every match still running ends on its server and the rest are cancelled. Nobody wins and no rewards are given. This cannot be undone.

signup.title: Sign up your team

placement.outBody: Your team is out of the tournament, so there are no more matches for you. Follow the rest in the bracket.
placement.wonBody: Your team won the tournament. Well played!
placement.outBodyPlay: You have no more matches in this tournament. Thanks for playing! Fancy another game? Matchmaking puts you in a match in a minute or two.

whatsNext.outBody: That was your last match in {{tournament}}. Good games! Want to keep playing? Matchmaking finds you a match with other players right now.
whatsNext.nextMatchReady: Your match is ready: open the match room to connect.
whatsNext.nextMatchSoon: Your next match is set. After a short break it opens, and we ping you. The navbar shows the countdown wherever you are.
whatsNext.waitingBody: Your opponent comes from a match still being played. When it ends there is a short break, then your next match opens. We ping you.
whatsNext.shuffleBody: When every match of this round is done, new teams are drawn and your next match shows up here.
whatsNext.stayHere: Stay on this page: it updates by itself.
whatsNext.winsToTitle_one: One more win for the title
whatsNext.shuffleDoneBody: The shuffle is over. Open the tournament for the standings.

shuffleJoin.inBody: Quando il torneo inizia viene sorteggiata la tua prima squadra e la tua partita compare qui. Tieni aperta questa pagina.
shuffleJoin.playingBody: Your team this round: {{team}}. Open the match to connect.
shuffleJoin.sittingOutBody: There aren't enough players for every team this round. You're in the draw for round {{next}}, and the ones who played most sit out first.

ties.round_robin: Ties: head-to-head, then round difference, then rounds won.
ties.swiss: Ties: how strong your opponents were (Buchholz: their wins added up), then round difference.
ties.elim: Ordered by wins. Two losses and a team is out.
ties.singleElim: Ordered by wins. One loss and a team is out.
ties.doubleElim: Ordered by wins. Two losses and a team is out.
ties.groups: Ties in a group: head-to-head, then round difference, then rounds won.

intro.round_robin: Round robin: every team plays every other team once.
intro.swiss: Swiss: each round pairs teams with the same record.
intro.single: Single elimination: one loss and a team is out.
intro.double: Double elimination: two losses and a team is out.
intro.groups: Groups, then playoffs: every team plays the others in its group once; the best go on to the playoffs.

captainsPanel.title: Captains
captainsPanel.note: Only a captain can report or confirm a result.

prizesPage.title: Prizes
prizesPage.intro: Skins for a placing, given to every player on the team when the tournament ends, and a prize for the MVP. Site skins only: no Steam items, no money value.
prizesPage.none: This tournament's game has no prizes.

schedulePage.title: Match times
schedulePage.intro: Give each round a start time, or a single match its own. Players see it on the match, get a reminder, and the veto opens on time.
schedulePage.modeTimesNote: Matches wait for their time. Open a round to give one match its own time.
schedulePage.modeAsapNote: No times: a match starts when both teams and a server are ready.
schedulePage.noRounds: The rounds show here once the bracket is made.
schedulePage.roundNote_one: {{count}} match · open to set its own time
schedulePage.roundNote_other: {{count}} matches · open to set one match’s time
schedulePage.roundNoMatches: Its matches are made when the round before ends
schedulePage.vetoNote: Opens by itself before each match, so it is done when the match starts. A team that does not act in time gets a map picked for it.
schedulePage.reminderNote: A notification on the site and in Discord, to every player in the match.

rules.start: Nothing about a match starts before its veto opens, even with a free server.
rules.late: A late round pushes the next one: a team still playing, or the break between matches, holds the veto, and players see the new time.
rules.none: No time set: as before, a match goes ahead as soon as both teams and a server are ready.
rules.where: The overview's schedule, the match cards, the match room, the rules and check-in show these times.

groups.playoffsSoon: The playoffs start when every group match is played.
